members.name: value
members.description: NativeSelectProps omits the native numeric size prop and replaces it with sm|default (default). Other native select props, including multiple, value/defaultValue, disabled, name and onChange are passed through. NativeSelectOption/OptGroup are option/optgroup. The extra ChevronDown is aria-hidden. className styles the surrounding wrapper, not the select.
